verses.en: We then, as workers together with him, beseech you also that ye receive not the grace of God in vain.
verses.pt: E nós, como trabalhadores conjuntamente com ele, rogamos que não tenhais recebido a graça de Deus em vão.
verses.en_web: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain,
verses.en_bbe: We then, working together with God, make our request to you not to take the grace of God to no purpose.

verses.en: (For he saith, I have heard thee in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured thee: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)
verses.pt: Porque ele diz: Em tempo agradável te ouvi, e no dia da salvação te socorri; eis agora o tempo agradável, eis agora o dia da salvação
verses.en_web: for he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
verses.en_bbe: (For he says, I have given ear to you at a good time, and I have been your helper in a day of salvation: see, now is the good time; now is the day of salvation):

verses.en: Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed:
verses.pt: Escândalo nenhum damos em coisa alguma, para que nosso trabalho não seja acusado.
verses.en_web: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
verses.en_bbe: Giving no cause for trouble in anything, so that no one may be able to say anything against our work;

verses.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses,
verses.pt: Mas em tudo nos fizemos agradáveis como trabalhadores de Deus, em muita tolerância, em aflições, em necessidades, em angústias;
verses.en_web: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
verses.en_bbe: But in everything making it clear that we are the servants of God, in quiet strength, in troubles, in need, in sorrow,

verses.en: In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.pt: Em açoites, em prisões, em tumultos, em trabalhos, em vigílias, em jejuns;
verses.en_web: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;
verses.en_bbe: In blows, in prisons, in attacks, in hard work, in watchings, in going without food;

verses.en: By pureness, by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,
verses.pt: Em pureza, em conhecimento, em paciência, em bondade, no Espírito Santo, em amor não fingido;
verses.en_web: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
verses.en_bbe: In a clean heart, in knowledge, in long waiting, in being kind, in the Holy Spirit, in true love,

verses.en: By the word of truth, by the power of God, by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.pt: Em palavra da verdade, em poder de Deus, com armas da justiça, à esquerda, e à direita;
verses.en_web: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
verses.en_bbe: In the true word, in the power of God; with the arms of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

verses.en: By honour and dishonour, by evil report and good report: as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.pt: Por honra e por desonra; por infâmia e por boa fama; considerados como enganadores, e como verdadeiros.
verses.en_web: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;
verses.en_bbe: By glory and by shame, by an evil name and a good name; as untrue, and still true;

verses.en: As unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and, behold, we live; as chastened, and not killed;
verses.pt: Como estranhos, e conhecidos; como morrendo, e eis que estamos vivendo; como castigados e ainda não mortos.
verses.en_web: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;
verses.en_bbe: Unnoted, but still kept fully in mind; as near to death, but still living; as undergoing punishment, but not put to death;

verses.en: As sorrowful, yet alway rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.pt: Como entristecidos, porém sempre alegres; como pobres, porém enriquecendo a muitos; como nada tendo, e possuindo tudo.
verses.en_web: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.
verses.en_bbe: As full of sorrow, but ever glad; as poor, but giving wealth to others; as having nothing, but still having all things.

verses.en: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
verses.pt: Para vós, ó coríntios, está aberta nossa boca; e nosso coração está ampliado.
verses.en_web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
verses.en_bbe: Our mouth is open to you, O Corinthians, our heart is wide.

verses.en: Ye are not straitened in us, but ye are straitened in your own bowels.
verses.pt: Nós não temos lhes estreitado, mas vós estais estreitos em nossos sentimentos.
verses.en_web: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
verses.en_bbe: It is not our feelings to you which are narrow, but yours to us.

verses.en: Now for a recompence in the same, (I speak as unto my children,) be ye also enlarged.
verses.pt: E em recompensa disto (falo como a filhos) alargai vós também.
verses.en_web: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also open your hearts.
verses.en_bbe: Now to give me back payment of the same sort (I am talking as to my children), let your hearts be wide open to me.

verses.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness? and what communion hath light with darkness?
verses.pt: Não vos ajunteis em outro jugo com os descrentes. Porque, que parceria tem a justiça com injustiça? E que parceria tem a luz com as trevas?
verses.en_web: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?
verses.en_bbe: Do not keep company with those who have not faith: for what is there in common between righteousness and evil, or between light and dark?

verses.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel?
verses.pt: E que acordo há entre Cristo e Belial? Ou que parte tem o crente com o incrédulo?
verses.en_web: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?
verses.en_bbe: And what agreement is there between Christ and the Evil One? or what part has one who has faith with one who has not?

verses.en: And what agreement hath the temple of God with idols? for ye are the temple of the living God; as God hath said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
verses.pt: E que acordo há entre o Templo de Deus e os ídolos? Porque vós sois o templo do Deus vivente, como Deus disse: Neles habitarei, e entre eles andarei; e eu serei seu Deus, e eles serão meu povo.
verses.en_web: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
verses.en_bbe: And what agreement has the house of God with images? for we are a house of the living God; even as God has said, I will be living among them, and walking with them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

verses.en: Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,
verses.pt: Portanto: saí do meio deles, e vos separai, diz o Senhor; e não toqueis coisa impura, e eu vos aceitarei.
verses.en_web: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
verses.en_bbe: For which cause, Come out from among them, and be separate, says the Lord, and let no unclean thing come near you; and I will take you for myself,

verses.en: And will be a Father unto you, and ye shall be my sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty.
verses.pt: E eu vos serei por Pai, e vós sereis para mim filhos e filhas,diz o Senhor Todo Poderoso.
verses.en_web: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
verses.en_bbe: And will be a Father to you; and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord, the Ruler of all.
